entries.title: The Diagnosis
entries.body: Three words from a doctor turned my whole life sideways. I remember staring at the ceiling tile, waiting for the room to stop tilting.

entries.title: The Darkest Winter
entries.body: Hospital ceilings became familiar. I stopped praying for a while — not out of anger, just exhaustion. I didn't know grief and faith could sit in the same room.

entries.title: A Whisper of Hope
entries.body: A nurse hummed "It Is Well" while changing my IV, and something in me cracked open. It was small. It was enough.

entries.title: Healing Begins
entries.body: My body started answering prayers my mouth had stopped praying. Slowly. Unevenly. But undeniably.

entries.title: Walking in Freedom
entries.body: I still have hard days. But I know now that Christ was never late — He was building something in me the whole time. This blog is what came out of the waiting.
